name: Morningstar Investor
description: Morningstar Investor is a consumer investment-research and portfolio-analysis product providing ratings, analyst research, screeners, watchlists, and portfolio tools. Individual investors use it to evaluate securities and monitor holdings through Morningstar's own applications.
